title: Model release engineering
summary: From a trained artifact to a version in production: registry and versioning, evaluation gates, CI/CD for ML, GitOps and Terraform, staged rollouts.
intro: Model release engineering covers the path from a trained artifact to a version serving production traffic: how the model is packaged and versioned, what evidence it must produce before promotion, and how automation moves it through environments. The lessons go from registry and evaluation gates through CI/CD and GitOps to progressive rollout and rollback.

lessons.title: Model evaluation: regression suites and release gates
CI/CD for models and services with GitHub Actions
Reproducible environments: GitOps with Argo CD and infrastructure as code with Terraform
Staged rollouts: shadow, canary, champion/challenger and rollback
